text:
Hi Sarah — I'd like to set up the CSE455 staff meeting for next week. My calendar is nearly full, so the open half-hours I have are:

- Monday 14:00-14:30
- Tuesday 15:00-15:30
- Wednesday 13:00-13:30

Would any of those work for you? If none do, send me the times you're free and I'll see what I can shift.

Hello — I'm arranging the CSE455 staff meeting for next week. The candidate times are Monday 14:00-14:30, Tuesday 15:00-15:30 or Wednesday 13:00-13:30.

Two things:
1. Could you hold a small room for it? I'll confirm the exact slot as soon as Sarah replies.
2. Is there anything official next week that isn't on my calendar yet (department meetings, seminars, room changes)?

Thank you.

Hi Professor Alvarez — Tuesday 15:00-15:30 works for me, so I've booked the CSE455 staff meeting then (my Tuesday has CSE455 office hours right after, so it lines up nicely).

Monday 14:00-14:30 I can't do — I'm in the seminar from 14:10. Wednesday 13:00-13:30 is also free if you'd rather have that one; just say the word and I'll move it.

Tuesday 15:00-15:30 it is — booked on my side too, and it sits nicely between grant writing and the research meeting. I've asked the department office to hold a room; I'll let you know what they say. No need to move anything else.
Great — it's on my calendar. Thanks for sorting the room with the department office; just send me the details when you hear back.

Hello Professor Alvarez — the department front office here.

1. I can't hold rooms or arrange meetings, I'm afraid; room bookings go through the department office. What I can do is tell you what the official schedule says about your candidate slots:
- Mon 14:00-14:30 runs into the Seminar (14:10-15:40) and the CSE455 lecture starts at 14:30.
- Tue 15:00-15:30 follows the CSE452 lecture (ends 15:00) and runs into CSE455 office hours at 15:30.
- Wed 13:00-13:30 has nothing official against it.

2. Official items next week that don't name you: Mon 14:10-15:40 Seminar, Mon 15:40-17:00 CSE444 lecture; Tue 09:50-11:10 Seminar, Tue 12:10-13:40 CSE444 lecture, Tue 13:40-15:00 CSE452 lecture, Tue 15:30-16:20 CSE455 office hours, Tue 16:20-17:00 CSE455 quiz section; Wed 09:00-10:00 CSE452 lecture, Wed 10:30-12:00 CSE455 office hours, Wed 13:30-14:20 CSE455 quiz section; Fri 14:50-15:50 Seminar, Fri 15:50-17:00 CSE444 lecture.

No cancellations or room changes are recorded for next week.

Thank you, that's exactly what I needed. We'll take Tuesday 15:00-15:30 for the CSE455 staff meeting — it ends right as the CSE455 office hours begin, so nothing official is disturbed.

One thing: if room bookings don't come through you, where should I send the request — is there a form or a person in the office I should write to?

And noted on the official items; I'll put the ones that touch CSE455 into my own calendar.

Details from the department office: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 is clean — it follows the CSE452 lecture and ends exactly when CSE455 office hours start, so no clash. They don't handle room bookings themselves, so I'm finding out where the request goes; I'll send you the room as soon as it's held. They also confirmed there are no cancellations or room changes next week.
Thanks for checking — good to know the slot is clean and nothing else moves next week. I'll keep 15:00-15:30 on Tuesday and wait for the room.

Noted — Tuesday 15:00-15:30 runs clean against the official schedule as I have it.

On bookings: I don't have a form or a named contact for room requests, and I don't arrange other people's meetings, so I can't point you to one with any certainty. The department office handles room bookings directly — whoever you normally write to there will have the current procedure.
Understood — thanks for confirming the slot runs clean. I'll route the room request the usual way.

One last try, then I'll stop: you're the only office contact I have, and the meeting does need a room. Could you either put a small room down for Tuesday 15:00-15:30 (CSE455 staff meeting, three or four of us), or tell me who to write to? If neither is possible, say so plainly and I'll make other arrangements.

Update: the office says they don't arrange meetings or hold rooms, and they can't name a contact either — it's the same office, so I'm going back to them once more with a plain request. If that fails, we'll simply meet in my office on Tuesday 15:00-15:30 and I'll sort a room for the next one. Nothing you need to do.

Plainly, then: I can't put a room down for you — I don't arrange or book meetings — and I don't have a person or a form to refer you to. So make other arrangements for the room, and please treat the Tuesday 15:00-15:30 slot as clean in the official schedule, which is all I can confirm.
Understood — and no problem at all. Your office on Tuesday 15:00-15:30 works fine for me if the room doesn't come through; the slot stays booked either way.
Understood — plain answer noted, thank you. I'll make other arrangements and take Tuesday 15:00-15:30 as clean in the official schedule.
Good — then it's settled: Tuesday 15:00-15:30, my office. I'll confirm the room if one turns up before then, otherwise we meet there.
